definitions.explanation: A place of worship in the Shinto religion, typically marked by a torii gate at the entrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{神社|じんじゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I go to the shrine on New Year's.
examples.notes: 初詣 (hatsumoude) - first shrine visit of the year

examples.japanese: {神社|じんじゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{お守|まも}り→お守り：05955_omamori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}いました→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought an amulet at the shrine.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{鳥居|とりい}→鳥居：05956_torii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{神社|じんじゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入|い}り{口|ぐち}→入り口：02507_iriguchi⟧です。
examples.english: That torii is the entrance to the shrine.

notes:
{神社|じんじゃ} is a Shinto shrine, distinct from Buddhist temples.

SHRINE vs TEMPLE:
- {神社|じんじゃ}: Shinto shrine (has torii gate)
- {お寺|てら}/{寺院|じいん}: Buddhist temple

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {神社|じんじゃ}に{参|まい}る: to visit a shrine
- {神社|じんじゃ}で{お参|まい}りする: to pray at a shrine
- {鳥居|とりい}: torii gate
- {お守|まも}り: amulet, charm
- {絵馬|えま}: votive tablet
- {おみくじ}: fortune slip

FAMOUS SHRINES:
- {伊勢|いせ}{神宮|じんぐう}: Ise Grand Shrine
- {明治|めいじ}{神宮|じんぐう}: Meiji Shrine
- {出雲|いずも}{大社|たいしゃ}: Izumo Grand Shrine
